title: end run leaves only your seat
why: His answer 2.23 a: in a two player raid end run takes out only the player who pressed it. Watch: try both exit orders and one exit followed by the other player extracting; the remaining window should keep playing until both are out.
now: End run keeps the world running for the other seat. Both exits settle the run with the existing early-end score penalty.

edits.anchor: // The run end, from idle or END RUN. Player 2 that is not the run authority goes out instead.
